_why:
#26 — the last mile on the ARG_MAX halt. The assembler's gate was proven twice at the KERNEL (a bisect at the syscall, and a test handing what the gate blesses to execve), but never against agy itself, so the halt's MESSAGE — 'no surface accepts a prompt this large' — was unverified: if agy truncated instead of refusing, the gate would be right for the wrong reason and the operator misled.

Measured 2026-09-13 against agy 1.2.2 (ARG_MAX 1,048,576): a 1,100,047 B argv raises `OSError 7 Argument list too long` at the syscall. agy does not truncate and does not report a limit of its own, so the message is TRUE. Free to probe, because execve fails before agy starts — no tokens are spent.

What the probe DID find is a reporting defect on the ungated path. `exec` takes any file and redirects the child's stderr to /dev/null, so the kernel's message vanished and the wrapper reported `EMPTY final message — agent exited 126 with no final message`, asserting the agent ran and said nothing when it was never entered. The guard is a REFUSAL rather than an advisory, and that is not a judgement call: the dispatch cannot succeed either way, so the only choice is whether the operator is told why.

mutations.name: the-oversize-guard-is-removed
mutations._mechanism: Restores the misdiagnosis: rc=126 with the kernel's reason discarded, reported as an agent that ran and returned nothing. The operator hunts a timeout or an empty reply instead of re-assembling smaller.

mutations.name: the-guard-refuses-every-prompt
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction. Real audit prompts run 16-90 KB, three orders of magnitude under the budget; a guard that fires on them blocks every dispatch while looking like a correct safety check.

mutations.name: the-refusal-stops-naming-the-remedy
mutations._mechanism: A refusal with no way forward is a wall. `--vh-tail N` is the documented first remedy for an oversize prompt and the reason the halt is survivable; without it the operator is told only that the thing they have cannot be sent.
mutations.find: echo "  Not a hang and not an empty reply — the prompt never left this machine. Re-assemble smaller: --vh-tail N is the first remedy." >&2
